The fold candidate adds exactly the four requested FishingTool-backed methods, preserves the emulator's item IDs, Fishing levels, min/max chances, XP, bait, and mixed-output order, keeps cave eel out of the live registry and explicitly deferred, and touches no Combat or Prayer code. The required python -c "import fishing_data" command passed, all nine focused Fishing/item-registry checks passed, and the full suite passed 920 tests with 157 skipped. items.detail: Faithfully transcribe only these game-main rows that have live runtime bindings but are absent from crafting_data.py: GlassData EMPTY_CANDLE_LANTERN (level 4, 19 XP), EMPTY_OIL_LAMP (12, 25), FISHBOWL (42, 42.5), LANTERN_LENS (49, 55), and EMPTY_LIGHT_ORB (87, 70); JewelleryData SLAYER_RING (gold bar + enchanted gem -> ring of slaying (8), level 75, 15 XP), retaining the source CRAFT_ROS unlock as a documented note without inventing a Slayer system; SilverData SILVTHRILL_ROD (silver bar + mithril bar + sapphire, level 25, 55 XP) and SILVTHRILL_CHAIN (silver bar + mithril bar, level 47, 100 XP); SpinningData CBOW_STRING1 (each of oak, willow, maple, yew, magic, and spirit roots is a source-accepted alternative input for one crossbow string at level 10 and 15 XP); and WeavingData MILESTONE_CAPES (tiers 10 through 90, balls of wool equal to tier/10, XP equal to tier). The milestone source gates on all skills at the tier; preserve that as a documented source constraint if the existing Crafting model cannot enforce it, and do not touch Combat or Prayer implementation. Input-starved rows are acceptable, but do not invent acquisition, bindings, values, or clamps. Use exact output names/IDs from game-main item definitions. Add focused tests and run tools/fetch_crafting_assets.py plus only necessary WIKI_TITLE_OVERRIDES until item-icon tests pass. PotteryData.NOT_URNS is a grouping wrapper, not an output row, and FishingTool.BARB_HARPOON has no FishingSpot binding; neither belongs in this task.
